verdict.rationale: OneDrive is reachable through the Microsoft Graph API, so asking about scoped agent credentials is fair for this product. However, nothing in the evidence pack covers permission scopes, app registration, least-privilege grants or credential issuance. The API docs cover file operations, delta queries and change notifications, none of which bears on credential scoping.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
